what: On hover, an accent-colored panel tilted 15° rises upright from below (175%) and covers the button, while the text swaps places with a duplicate (shadow) hidden 1.6em below and slides upward. In the right icon cell the background turns 90° and the icon exits to the right as the same icon enters from the left — all .525s cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1). Pressing squeezes to .965 in .18s. Keyboard focus gets the same look + an outer ring.

options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Icon (optional, svg) — if present, placed twice in the 2.1em slot on the right
options.look: ghost: Transparent background + thin border (the original’s ”View tech” button)
options.--fx-bg · --fx-ink · --fx-hover · --fx-h: Background · text · hover panel · hover text · icon cell · icon color (via style) — original light button is --fx-bg: cream · --fx-ink: ink · --fx-icon-bg: ink · --fx-icon-ink: cream

use: Get a quote
note: Hides the panel on devices without a hand. With reduced motion, the background color changes in .2s instead of the panel

from.where: shared.css .btn (original .btn — plate 175% · 15°, text text-shadow 1.6em, icon 200% · background 90°, .525s cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1), press .965 .18s) — header · hero · card · closing buttons
